items.title: The US has had the tools to control measles for almost 65 years. Here’s how it’s come raging back
items.brief: The United States is experiencing its worst and deadliest year for measles since 1991, with 10 measles-associated deaths so far in 2026 – half of which were reported in the past two weeks.

items.title: After 26 years, the US has lost its measles elimination status
items.brief: Thanks to widespread vaccination, measles had been considered “eliminated” as a continually transmitting illness in the United States since 2000 – but not anymore.
